Class McpInstrumentAccess

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.mcp.McpInstrumentAccess
@Component @ConditionalOnProperty(prefix="gt.use", name="mcp", havingValue="true") public class McpInstrumentAccess extends Object
Checks every id a client passes before a report sees it. The reports silently skip foreign ids - an empty answer for a foreign cash account, a foreign account dropped from a selection - and an empty report must never be the answer to a foreign id. A model guesses ids, so a foreign id is answered with McpErrorCode.NOT_OWNED and does not count as a security breach of the user.

  • Method Details

    • requireVisibleSecurity

      public Security requireVisibleSecurity(McpCaller caller, Integer idSecuritycurrency, String parameter)
      Returns a security the tenant may see: a public one, with or without holdings, or a private one of the tenant. The reports load an instrument without any tenant check, so this runs before the first use of a passed id. An invisible security is refused without revealing its name, ISIN or anything else about it.
      Parameters:
      caller - the caller, whose home tenant decides the visibility
      idSecuritycurrency - the id passed by the client
      parameter - the name of the tool parameter, for the error
      Returns:
      the visible security
